Context: Earlier, open-source large models like Mimo V2.5 Pro, DeepSeek V4 Pro (first version), and Kimi K2.5 used to struggle with this prompt, and Qwen 3.6 27B couldn't even render the globe properly. But now, Qwen 3.8 27B is so much better than the previous model.

I hope qwen publishes some papers that may help other labs to create such good small models.

Setup: fp8 + lmstudio + opencode. Idk what settings as my friend helped me to run this prompt on his setup.
